title: Police Bust Down Door on Surprise Drug Raid
description:
On March 1, 2021, police conducted a second confidential purchase of methamphetamine from a man in La Crosse, WI. That evening, police obtained a search warrant for the man's residence. After they knocked and identified themselves, the man locked the door. As a result, police utilized a battering ram to make entrance into the residence.
